📦 **ArtGallery `95c3c82`** — art: exhibit four new women production occupations

TASK-1050: salt-fish curer, potter, glassmaker and soap maker, each independently generated using attached Astrid style reference. Original cyan hair / magenta clothing are explicit material keys; working props, skin, linen and leather retain natural colours. Existing female fisher already present, so this batch adds genuinely new job keys rather than duplicating her. Four portrait cards preserve exact prompts, source/reference SHA256 and full-body originals. Gallery build/check pass1111exhibits; browser gallery interaction not verified. Game import follows this commit.

Refs TASK-1050
